integrity: The counterexample satisfies the source's printed alignment inequality, strong convexity, compact convex feasibility, zero-noise variance condition, quasi-gradient definition, and linear-growth requirement. The source diminishing-step schedule is replayed exactly with rational arithmetic. No later extension is claimed validated by the repair.
scientific_limitations: The finding isolates the sign defect in the strongly convex operator-alignment condition and the conclusions that use its invalid implication. The corrected lower alignment inequality repairs that specific directional step only when a suitable positive lower bound for the base operator has been established independently.
title: A one-dimensional sign counterexample to the proposed operator-alignment condition
